---
title: "Teacher Dashboard"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

<style>
.teacher-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: end;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.teacher-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.teacher-field label {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.teacher-field input,
.teacher-field select {
  min-width: 150px;
  padding: 6px 8px;
}

.teacher-button {
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #777;
  border-radius: 5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: white;
}

.teacher-button:hover {
  background: #f3f3f3;
}

.teacher-button-primary {
  background: #0d6efd;
  color: white;
  border-color: #0d6efd;
}

.teacher-button-primary:hover {
  background: #0b5ed7;
}

.teacher-button-success {
  background: #198754;
  color: white;
  border-color: #198754;
}

.teacher-button-success:hover {
  background: #157347;
}

.teacher-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: wait;
}

.review-button {
  margin-top: 5px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

#loginBox {
  max-width: 650px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

#loginBox input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 8px;
  margin: 8px 0 12px 0;
}

#dashboard {
  display: none;
}

/* Classroom access panel */

.session-panel {
  border: 1px solid #d7d7d7;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  background: #fafafa;
}

.session-panel-title {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.session-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: end;
}

.session-display {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid #198754;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: white;
}

.session-display.open {
  display: block;
}

.session-status {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.session-code {
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 5px 0 8px 0;
}

.session-meta {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.session-countdown {
  font-weight: 700;
}

.summary-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(130px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 18px 0;
}

.summary-card {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 12px;
}

.summary-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #666;
}

.summary-value {
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

#message {
  margin: 12px 0;
}

.teacher-table-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.teacher-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.teacher-table th,
.teacher-table td {
  padding: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.teacher-table th {
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.teacher-table input[type="number"] {
  width: 75px;
}

.teacher-table input[type="text"] {
  min-width: 200px;
  width: 100%;
}

.status-final {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.status-needs_review {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.small-muted {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #666;
}

.final-hint {
  margin-top: 3px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #666;
}

/* Full-width review row */

.review-row {
  display: none;
}

.review-row.open {
  display: table-row;
}

.review-row > td {
  padding: 0 8px 18px 8px;
  background: #fafafa;
}

.review-panel {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.review-heading {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.review-heading-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.review-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 3fr) minmax(280px, 2fr);
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: start;
}

.review-section-title {
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
}

.code-box {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #f5f5f5;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.code-box pre {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 14px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  min-height: 120px;
  max-height: 500px;
  background: #f5f5f5;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.code-box code {
  white-space: pre;
}

.review-info-box {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  background: white;
}

.hidden-test {
  padding: 5px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
}

.hidden-test:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.hidden-test-fail {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.ai-feedback {
  line-height: 1.45;
}

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  .review-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .summary-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}
</style>

<script>
(() => {

const API_BASE =
  "https://itarch-backend-fpdsf6brfpanf5d8.northeurope-01.azurewebsites.net/api";

let allRows = [];
const assessmentSlots = [
 ...Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>({id:`warmup${i+1}`,label:`Warmup ${i+1}`})),
 {id:'quiz1',label:'Quiz 1'},{id:'quiz2',label:'Quiz 2'},
 {id:'final',label:'End-term test'},{id:'project',label:'Project'}
];
function isPracticeQuiz(){return testSelect.value==='midterm01-practice'}
function isOfficialQuiz(){return testSelect.value==='midterm01'}
function updateTestControls(){openSessionButton.disabled=!/^week\d{2}$/.test(testSelect.value);document.getElementById('openQuizButton').disabled=!isOfficialQuiz();document.getElementById('evaluateButton').disabled=testSelect.value==='midterm02';document.getElementById('finalizeUnchangedButton').disabled=testSelect.value==='midterm02';}


const loginBox =
  document.getElementById("loginBox");

const dashboard =
  document.getElementById("dashboard");

const functionKey =
  document.getElementById("functionKey");

const loginMessage =
  document.getElementById("loginMessage");

const resultsBody =
  document.getElementById("resultsBody");

const summary =
  document.getElementById("summary");

const message =
  document.getElementById("message");

const groupFilter =
  document.getElementById("groupFilter");

const statusFilter =
  document.getElementById("statusFilter");

const testSelect =
  document.getElementById("testSelect");

const sessionGroupSelect =
  document.getElementById("sessionGroupSelect");

const openSessionButton =
  document.getElementById("openSessionButton");

const sessionDisplay =
  document.getElementById("sessionDisplay");

const sessionStatus =
  document.getElementById("sessionStatus");

const sessionCode =
  document.getElementById("sessionCode");

const sessionLabel =
  document.getElementById("sessionLabel");

const sessionCountdown =
  document.getElementById("sessionCountdown");

let sessionTimer = null;
let sessionExpiresAt = null;


function getKey() {
  return sessionStorage.getItem(
    "teacher_function_key"
  ) || "";
}


function setMessage(text, error = false) {
  message.textContent = text;

  message.style.color =
    error ? "#b00020" : "";
}


function apiUrl(functionName) {
  const key = getKey();

  return (
    `${API_BASE}/${functionName}` +
    `?code=${encodeURIComponent(key)}`
  );
}


// Export all semester results for Group, independently of Test / Status filters.
document.getElementById('exportDashboardButton').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const button = document.getElementById('exportDashboardButton');
  const group = groupFilter.value;
  if (!group) { setMessage('Select a group (G01–G07) before exporting.', true); return; }
  if (!getKey()) { setMessage('Enter the teacher key first.', true); return; }
  button.disabled = true;
  setMessage(`Preparing the semester results for ${group}…`);
  let downloadUrl;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(apiUrl('exportDashboard') + '&group=' + encodeURIComponent(group), {cache:'no-store'});
    if (!response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(data.error || `Export failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
    }
    const blob = await response.blob();
    downloadUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = downloadUrl;
    link.download = `dashboard-${group}-${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.xlsx`;
    document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); link.remove();
    setMessage(`Excel export downloaded for ${group}. Latest finalized semester results; Test and Status filters do not restrict this export.`);
  } catch (error) { setMessage(error.message || 'Export failed. Please retry.', true); }
  finally {
    button.disabled = false;
    if (downloadUrl) setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl), 60000);
  }
});


function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
    .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
}


async function readJsonResponse(
  response,
  fallbackMessage
) {
  const text =
    await response.text();

  let data = {};

  if (text) {
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      throw new Error(
        `${fallbackMessage} ` +
        `(HTTP ${response.status}: invalid response)`
      );
    }
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      data.error ||
      `${fallbackMessage} (HTTP ${response.status})`
    );
  }

  return data;
}


/* -------------------------------------------------
   Classroom access
------------------------------------------------- */

function stopSessionCountdown() {
  if (sessionTimer) {
    clearInterval(sessionTimer);
    sessionTimer = null;
  }
}


function updateSessionCountdown() {
  if (!sessionExpiresAt) {
    sessionCountdown.textContent = "--:--";
    return;
  }

  const remaining =
    Math.max(
      0,
      sessionExpiresAt.getTime() -
      Date.now()
    );

  const totalSeconds =
    Math.ceil(
      remaining / 1000
    );

  const minutes =
    Math.floor(
      totalSeconds / 60
    );

  const seconds =
    totalSeconds % 60;

  sessionCountdown.textContent =
    `${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:` +
    `${String(seconds).padStart(2, "0")}`;

  if (remaining <= 0) {
    stopSessionCountdown();

    sessionStatus.textContent =
      "Access expired";

    sessionCode.textContent =
      "------";
  }
}


function showOpenedSession(data) {
  sessionExpiresAt =
    new Date(data.expires_at);

  sessionCode.textContent =
    data.access_code || "------";

  sessionLabel.textContent =
    `${data.test_id} · ${data.session_group}`;

  sessionStatus.textContent =
    "Access open";

  sessionDisplay.classList.add("open");

  stopSessionCountdown();
  updateSessionCountdown();

  sessionTimer =
    setInterval(
      updateSessionCountdown,
      1000
    );
}


async function openTestSession() {
  const testId =
    testSelect.value;

  const sessionGroup =
    sessionGroupSelect.value;

  if (!sessionGroup) {
    setMessage(
      "Select a default group.",
      true
    );
    return;
  }

  openSessionButton.disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("openQuizButton").disabled = true;

  setMessage(
    `Opening ${testId} for ${sessionGroup}...`
  );

  try {
    const response =
      await fetch(
        apiUrl(isOfficialQuiz()?"openQuizSession":"openTestSession"),
        {
          method: "POST",

          headers: {
            "Content-Type":
              "application/json"
          },

          body: JSON.stringify({
            test_id:
              testId,

            session_group:
              sessionGroup,

            access_minutes:
              3
          })
        }
      );

    const data =
      await readJsonResponse(
        response,
        "Test access could not be opened."
      );

    if (
      !data.success ||
      !data.access_code
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        "Test access could not be opened."
      );
    }

    showOpenedSession(data);

    setMessage(
      `${testId} opened for ${sessionGroup}. ` +
      `Classroom code: ${data.access_code}`
    );

  } catch (error) {
    setMessage(
      error.message,
      true
    );

  } finally {
    updateTestControls();
  }
}


/* -------------------------------------------------
   Results
------------------------------------------------- */

async function loadResults() {
  if(testSelect.value==='midterm02'){allRows=[];renderRows();updateTestControls();setMessage('Quiz 2 is listed for semester planning; its official test is not configured yet.');return;}
  const testId =
    testSelect.value;

  setMessage(
    "Loading results..."
  );

  const url =
    apiUrl(isOfficialQuiz()?"teacherOfficialQuizResults":isPracticeQuiz()?"teacherQuizResults":"teacherResults") +
    `&test_id=${encodeURIComponent(testId)}`;

  const response =
    await fetch(url);

  const data =
    await readJsonResponse(
      response,
      "Could not load teacher results."
    );

  if (!data.success) {
    throw new Error(
      data.error ||
      "Could not load teacher results."
    );
  }

  allRows =
    data.submissions || [];
  updateTestControls();

  renderRows();

  setMessage(
    `${allRows.length} submission(s) loaded.`
  );
}


function filteredRows() {
  const group =
    groupFilter.value;

  const status =
    statusFilter.value;

  return allRows.filter(row => {
    if (
      group &&
      row.group !== group
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    if (
      status &&
      row.status !== status
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  });
}


function renderFilteredSummary(rows) {
  const evaluated =
    rows.filter(
      row =>
        row.preliminary_score !== null &&
        Number.isFinite(
          Number(row.preliminary_score)
        )
    );

  const finalized =
    rows.filter(
      row =>
        row.review_status === "final"
    );

  const needsReview =
    rows.filter(
      row =>
        row.status === "needs_review"
    );

  const average =
    evaluated.length
      ? evaluated.reduce(
          (sum, row) =>
            sum +
            Number(row.preliminary_score),
          0
        ) / evaluated.length
      : null;

  const cards = [
    ["Submissions", rows.length],
    ["Evaluated", evaluated.length],
    ["Finalized", finalized.length],
    ["Needs review", needsReview.length],
    [
      "Average",
      average === null
        ? "–"
        : Math.round(average * 100) / 100
    ]
  ];

  summary.innerHTML =
    cards.map(
      ([label, value]) => `
        <div class="summary-card">
          <div class="summary-label">
            ${escapeHtml(label)}
          </div>

          <div class="summary-value">
            ${escapeHtml(value)}
          </div>
        </div>
      `
    ).join("");
}


function hiddenTestsHtml(hiddenTests) {
  if (
    !hiddenTests ||
    !Array.isArray(hiddenTests.results)
  ) {
    return `
      <div class="small-muted">
        No hidden-test details available.
      </div>
    `;
  }

  const passed =
    Number(hiddenTests.passed || 0);

  const total =
    Number(
      hiddenTests.total ||
      hiddenTests.results.length
    );

  const tests =
    hiddenTests.results.map(
      (test, index) => {
        const ok =
          Boolean(test.passed);

        let details = "";

        if (test.timeout) {
          details += `
            <div class="small-muted">
              Timeout
            </div>
          `;
        }

        if (test.error) {
          details += `
            <div class="small-muted">
              ${escapeHtml(test.error)}
            </div>
          `;
        }

        return `
          <div class="
            hidden-test
            ${ok ? "" : "hidden-test-fail"}
          ">
            ${ok ? "✓" : "✗"}
            ${escapeHtml(
              test.name ||
              `Test ${index + 1}`
            )}

            ${details}
          </div>
        `;
      }
    ).join("");

  return `
    <div class="small-muted"
         style="margin-bottom:6px;">
      ${passed}/${total} passed
    </div>

    ${tests}
  `;
}


function elapsedTime(seconds) {
  if(typeof seconds !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return 'Not recorded';
  const whole = Math.floor(seconds);
  return `${Math.floor(whole / 60)} min ${whole % 60} sec`;
}

function reviewPanelHtml(row) {
  const solutions =
    Array.isArray(row.solutions)
      ? row.solutions
      : [];

  if (!solutions.length) {
    return `
      <div class="review-panel">
        <div class="small-muted">
          No submitted source code is available.
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  const theory = row.theory ? `<div class="review-panel"><strong>Theory: ${escapeHtml(row.theory.score)} / ${escapeHtml(row.theory.max)}</strong><p>${Object.entries(row.theory.perQuestion||{}).map(([id,ok])=>`Q${escapeHtml(id)}: ${ok?'✓':'✗'} (answer: ${escapeHtml(row.answers?.[id]||'—')})`).join(' · ')}</p></div>` : '';
  return `<div class="review-panel"><strong>Time spent: ${escapeHtml(elapsedTime(row.duration_seconds))}</strong><div class="small-muted">Elapsed time from test start to submission, including reading and thinking.</div></div>` + theory + solutions.map(
    (solution, index) => {
      const code =
        solution.code || "";

      const hiddenTests =
        solution.hidden_tests || {};

      const aiEvaluation =
        solution.ai_evaluation || {};

      const aiScore = aiEvaluation.score;
      const aiMaximum = aiEvaluation.max_score ?? solution.max_score;
      const aiScoreHtml = typeof aiScore === "number" && Number.isFinite(aiScore)
        ? `<p><strong>AI preliminary score: ${escapeHtml(aiScore)}${typeof aiMaximum === "number" && Number.isFinite(aiMaximum) ? ` / ${escapeHtml(aiMaximum)}` : ""} points</strong></p>`
        : '<p class="small-muted">AI preliminary score: not available.</p>';

      const aiFeedback =
        aiEvaluation.feedback ||
        row.preliminary_feedback ||
        "No AI feedback available.";

      const taskId =
        solution.task_id || "";

      const heading =
        solutions.length > 1
          ? `Task ${index + 1}: ${taskId}`
          : (
              row.task_titles?.[0] ||
              taskId ||
              "Submitted solution"
            );

      return `
        <div class="review-panel">

          ${solution.text?`<p style="white-space:pre-wrap">${escapeHtml(solution.text)}</p>`:''}
          ${solution.image&&/^data:image\/(svg\+xml|png);base64,/.test(solution.image)?`<img src="${escapeHtml(solution.image)}" alt="Task diagram" style="max-width:100%;max-height:800px">`:''}
          ${solution.max_score?`<p class="small-muted">Task maximum: ${escapeHtml(solution.max_score)} points</p>`:''}
          <div class="review-heading">

            <div>
              <div class="review-heading-title">
                ${escapeHtml(solution.title||heading)}
              </div>

              <div class="small-muted">
                Student:
                ${escapeHtml(row.neptun)}
                &nbsp; · &nbsp;
                Run count:
                ${escapeHtml(
                  solution.run_count ?? 0
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="review-grid">

            <div>

              <div class="review-section-title">
                Student code
              </div>

              <div class="code-box">
                <pre><code>${escapeHtml(code)}</code></pre>
              </div>

            </div>

            <div>

              <div class="review-section-title">
                Hidden tests
              </div>

              <div class="review-info-box">
                ${hiddenTestsHtml(hiddenTests)}
              </div>

              <div class="review-section-title">
                AI feedback
              </div>

              <div class="
                review-info-box
                ai-feedback
              ">
                ${aiScoreHtml}
                ${escapeHtml(aiFeedback)}
              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        </div>
      `;
    }
  ).join("");
}


function renderRows() {
  const rows =
    filteredRows();

  renderFilteredSummary(rows);

  resultsBody.innerHTML = "";

  if (!rows.length) {
    resultsBody.innerHTML = `
      <tr>
        <td colspan="9">
          No matching submissions.
        </td>
      </tr>
    `;

    return;
  }

  for (const row of rows) {
    const tr =
      document.createElement("tr");

    const taskTitle =
      Array.isArray(row.task_titles)
        ? row.task_titles.join(", ")
        : "";

    const preliminary =
      row.preliminary_score === null
        ? "–"
        : `${row.preliminary_score} / ${row.max_score}`;

    const defaultFinal =
      row.final_score !== null
        ? row.final_score
        : (
            row.preliminary_score !== null
              ? row.preliminary_score
              : ""
          );

    const isFinal =
      row.review_status === "final";

    const actionLabel =
      isFinal
        ? "Update final result"
        : "Save & finalize";

    const finalHint =
      isFinal
        ? "Final score"
        : (
            row.preliminary_score !== null
              ? "Suggested"
              : ""
          );

    tr.innerHTML = `

      <td>
        ${escapeHtml(row.group || "–")}
      </td>

      <td>
        <strong>
          ${escapeHtml(row.neptun)}
        </strong><div class="small-muted">${escapeHtml(row.submitted_at?new Date(row.submitted_at).toLocaleString():"")}</div>
      </td>

      <td>

        <strong>
          ${escapeHtml(taskTitle)}
        </strong>

        <br>

        <button
          type="button"
          class="teacher-button review-button">
          Review details
        </button>

      </td>

      <td>
        ${escapeHtml(preliminary)}
      </td>

      <td>

        <input
          type="number"
          min="0"
          max="${escapeHtml(row.max_score ?? 10)}"
          step="0.5"
          value="${escapeHtml(defaultFinal)}"
          class="final-score"
        />

        ${
          finalHint
            ? `
              <div class="final-hint">
                ${escapeHtml(finalHint)}
              </div>
            `
            : ""
        }

      </td>

      <td>
        ${
          row.submission_type === "window_switch"
            ? '<strong title="Automatic submission caused by the window-switch rule">⚠ Window switch</strong>'
            : row.submission_type === "timeout"
              ? '<strong title="Automatic submission when the time limit expired">Timeout</strong>'
              : escapeHtml(
                  row.submission_type === "manual"
                    ? "Manual"
                    : (row.submission_type || "Manual")
                )
        }
      </td>

      <td class="status-${escapeHtml(row.status)}">
        ${escapeHtml(row.status)}
      </td>

      <td>
        <label class="small-muted">Semester assessment</label>
        <select class="assessment-slot">${assessmentSlots.filter(a=>isOfficialQuiz()?a.id==='quiz1':!isPracticeQuiz()||a.id.startsWith('quiz')).map(a=>`<option value="${a.id}" ${a.id===row.assessment_slot?'selected':''}>${a.label}</option>`).join('')}</select>
        <label class="small-muted"><input type="checkbox" class="counts-grade" ${isOfficialQuiz()?'disabled':''} ${row.counts_toward_grade!==false?'checked':''}> Include in semester result</label>
        <div class="small-muted">${isPracticeQuiz()?'Practice attempt: enable inclusion only after an explicit grading decision.':''}</div>
        <input
          type="text"
          class="teacher-comment"
          value="${escapeHtml(
            row.teacher_comment || ""
          )}"
          placeholder="Optional comment"
        />

      </td>

      <td>

        <button
          class="teacher-button save-review">
          ${escapeHtml(actionLabel)}
        </button>
        ${String(row.group||'').toUpperCase()==='G07' ? '<button type="button" class="teacher-button delete-teacher-test">Delete</button>' : ''}

        ${
          isFinal
            ? `
              <div class="small-muted">
                Finalized
              </div>
            `
            : ""
        }

      </td>
    `;

    resultsBody.appendChild(tr);

    const reviewTr =
      document.createElement("tr");

    reviewTr.className =
      "review-row";

    reviewTr.innerHTML = `
      <td colspan="9">
        ${reviewPanelHtml(row)}
      </td>
    `;

    resultsBody.appendChild(reviewTr);

    const reviewButton =
      tr.querySelector(".review-button");

    reviewButton.addEventListener(
      "click",
      () => {
        const open =
          reviewTr.classList.toggle("open");

        reviewButton.textContent =
          open
            ? "Hide details"
            : "Review details";
      }
    );

    const deleteButton = tr.querySelector('.delete-teacher-test');
    if(deleteButton) deleteButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if(!window.confirm(`Delete the G07 test submission for ${row.neptun}?\n\nIts review and saved attempt will be removed from the dashboards. A private backup is kept. This allows a fresh test attempt.`)) return;
      deleteButton.disabled = true;
      try {
        const response = await fetch(apiUrl('deleteTeacherTest'), {
          method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
          body:JSON.stringify({test_id:row.test_id||testSelect.value,neptun:row.neptun,submission_id:row.submission_id,confirm:true})
        });
        const data = await readJsonResponse(response,'Teacher test could not be deleted.');
        if(!data.success) throw new Error(data.error||'Deletion failed.');
        // Clear only this browser's matching G07 official-quiz cache, so reload can start anew.
        if(row.test_id === 'midterm01') {
          try {
            const key='python-course-official-midterm01-v1', saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)||'null');
            if(saved?.attempt?.neptun===row.neptun && saved.attempt.attemptId===row.submission_id) localStorage.removeItem(key);
          } catch(_) {}
        }
        await loadResults();
        setMessage('G07 test deleted. Open a new classroom code for a fresh attempt.');
      } catch(error) { setMessage(error.message);deleteButton.disabled = false; }
    });

    const saveButton =
      tr.querySelector(".save-review");

    saveButton.addEventListener(
      "click",
      async () => {
        const scoreInput =
          tr.querySelector(".final-score");

        const commentInput =
          tr.querySelector(".teacher-comment");

        await saveReview(
          row,
          scoreInput.value,
          commentInput.value,
          saveButton,
          tr.querySelector(".assessment-slot").value,
          tr.querySelector(".counts-grade").checked
        );
      }
    );
  }
}


async function saveReviewRequest(
  row,
  score,
  comment,
  slot = row.assessment_slot,
  counts = row.counts_toward_grade !== false
) {
  const response =
    await fetch(
      apiUrl(row.test_id==='midterm01'?"saveOfficialQuizReview":row.test_id==='midterm01-practice'?"saveQuizReview":"saveReview"),
      {
        method: "POST",

        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/json"
        },

        body: JSON.stringify({
          expected_revision: row.revision,
          assessment_slot: slot,
          counts_toward_grade: counts,
          test_id:
            row.test_id || testSelect.value,

          submission_id:
            row.submission_id,

          final_score:
            Number(score),

          teacher_comment:
            comment || "",

          finalize:
            true,

          reviewed_by:
            "instructor"
        })
      }
    );

  const data =
    await readJsonResponse(
      response,
      `Review could not be saved for ${row.neptun}.`
    );

  if (!data.success) {
    throw new Error(
      data.error ||
      `Review could not be saved for ${row.neptun}.`
    );
  }

  return data;
}


async function saveReview(
  row,
  scoreValue,
  comment,
  button,
  slot,
  counts
) {
  const score =
    Number(scoreValue);

  if (String(scoreValue).trim()==="" || !Number.isFinite(score) || score<0 || score>Number(row.max_score)) {
    setMessage(
      `Invalid final score for ${row.neptun}.`,
      true
    );

    return;
  }

  button.disabled = true;

  setMessage(
    `Saving review for ${row.neptun}...`
  );

  try {
    await saveReviewRequest(
      row,
      score,
      comment,
      slot,
      counts
    );

    setMessage(
      `${row.neptun} finalized successfully. ${counts===false?"Excluded from the semester result.":"Student Dashboard updated."}`
    );

    await loadResults();

  } catch (error) {
    setMessage(
      error.message,
      true
    );

  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}


function unchangedRows() {
  const displayed = Array.from(resultsBody.querySelectorAll('tr')).filter(tr=>tr.querySelector('.final-score'));
  const changed = new Set();
  filteredRows().forEach((row,i)=>{
    const tr=displayed[i];if(!tr)return;
    if(tr.querySelector('.final-score').value!==String(row.preliminary_score??'') ||
       tr.querySelector('.teacher-comment').value!==(row.teacher_comment||'') ||
       tr.querySelector('.assessment-slot').value!==row.assessment_slot ||
       tr.querySelector('.counts-grade').checked!==(row.counts_toward_grade!==false)) changed.add(row.submission_id);
  });
  return filteredRows().filter(
    row => {
      if(changed.has(row.submission_id))return false;
      if (
        row.review_status === "final"
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        row.status === "needs_review"
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        row.preliminary_score === null
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(
          Number(row.preliminary_score)
        )
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    }
  );
}


async function finalizeUnchanged() {
  const button =
    document.getElementById(
      "finalizeUnchangedButton"
    );

  const rows =
    unchangedRows();

  if (!rows.length) {
    setMessage(
      "No unchanged results are available for finalization."
    );

    return;
  }

  const groupText =
    groupFilter.value
      ? ` in ${groupFilter.value}`
      : "";

  const confirmed =
    window.confirm(
      `Finalize ${rows.length} unchanged result(s)${groupText}?\n\n` +
      `Each preliminary score will become the final score.\n` +
      `Teacher comments will remain empty.\n\n` +
      `Final results can still be updated individually later.`
    );

  if (!confirmed) {
    return;
  }

  button.disabled = true;

  let completed = 0;

  try {
    for (const row of rows) {
      setMessage(
        `Finalizing ${completed + 1}/${rows.length}: ` +
        `${row.neptun}...`
      );

      await saveReviewRequest(
        row,
        row.preliminary_score,
        ""
      );

      completed++;
    }

    await loadResults();

    setMessage(
      `${completed} unchanged result(s) finalized successfully.`
    );

  } catch (error) {
    await loadResults();

    setMessage(
      `${completed}/${rows.length} result(s) were finalized. ` +
      `Processing stopped: ${error.message}`,
      true
    );

  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}


async function evaluatePending() {
  const button =
    document.getElementById(
      "evaluateButton"
    );

  button.disabled = true;

  try {
    let remaining = null;
    let batch = 0;

    do {
      batch++;

      setMessage(
        `Evaluating batch ${batch}...`
      );

      const response =
        await fetch(
          apiUrl(isOfficialQuiz()?"evaluateOfficialQuiz":isPracticeQuiz()?"evaluateQuizPractice":"evaluateTest"),
          {
            method: "POST",

            headers: {
              "Content-Type":
                "application/json"
            },

            body: JSON.stringify({
              test_id:
                testSelect.value
            })
          }
        );

      const data =
        await readJsonResponse(
          response,
          "Evaluation failed."
        );

      if (
        data.failed_this_batch > 0
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          `Evaluation stopped: ` +
          `${data.failed_this_batch} ` +
          `submission(s) failed.`
        );
      }

      remaining =
        Number(data.remaining || 0);

      setMessage(
        remaining > 0
          ? `${remaining} submission(s) remaining...`
          : "Evaluation completed."
      );

    } while (remaining > 0);

    await loadResults();

  } catch (error) {
    setMessage(
      error.message,
      true
    );

  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}


/* -------------------------------------------------
   Login
------------------------------------------------- */

async function login() {
  const key =
    functionKey.value.trim();

  if (!key) {
    loginMessage.textContent =
      "Enter the Function key.";

    return;
  }

  sessionStorage.setItem(
    "teacher_function_key",
    key
  );

  loginMessage.textContent =
    "Checking access...";

  try {
    await loadResults();

    loginBox.style.display =
      "none";

    dashboard.style.display =
      "block";

  } catch (error) {
    sessionStorage.removeItem(
      "teacher_function_key"
    );

    loginMessage.textContent =
      error.message;
  }
}


/* -------------------------------------------------
   Event listeners
------------------------------------------------- */

document
  .getElementById("loginButton")
  .addEventListener(
    "click",
    login
  );


functionKey.addEventListener(
  "keydown",
  event => {
    if (event.key === "Enter") {
      login();
    }
  }
);


document.getElementById('openQuizButton').addEventListener('click',openTestSession);

openSessionButton.addEventListener(
  "click",
  openTestSession
);


document
  .getElementById("refreshButton")
  .addEventListener(
    "click",
    async () => {
      try {
        await loadResults();
      } catch (error) {
        setMessage(
          error.message,
          true
        );
      }
    }
  );


document
  .getElementById("evaluateButton")
  .addEventListener(
    "click",
    evaluatePending
  );


document
  .getElementById(
    "finalizeUnchangedButton"
  )
  .addEventListener(
    "click",
    finalizeUnchanged
  );


document
  .getElementById("logoutButton")
  .addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => {
      sessionStorage.removeItem(
        "teacher_function_key"
      );

      location.reload();
    }
  );


groupFilter.addEventListener(
  "change",
  renderRows
);


statusFilter.addEventListener(
  "change",
  renderRows
);


testSelect.addEventListener(
  "change",
  async () => {
    stopSessionCountdown();

    sessionExpiresAt = null;

    sessionDisplay.classList.remove(
      "open"
    );

    sessionCode.textContent = "";

    try {
      await loadResults();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(
        error.message,
        true
      );
    }
  }
);

// Password tools use the same teacher function key as assessment administration.
let passwordRows=[],passwordBusy=false;
const pwEl=id=>document.getElementById(id);
async function passwordApi(method,body){
 if(!getKey())throw Error('Enter your teacher key first.');
 const group=pwEl('passwordGroup').value.trim();
 const url=apiUrl('teacherStudentPasswords')+(method==='GET'?'&group='+encodeURIComponent(group):'');
 const r=await fetch(url,{method,headers:method==='POST'?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:undefined,body:method==='POST'?JSON.stringify(body):undefined,cache:'no-store'});
 const d=await r.json();if(!r.ok||!d.success)throw Error(d.error||'Password operation failed.');return d;
}
function passwordRender(){
 pwEl('passwordBody').innerHTML=passwordRows.map(row=>`<tr><td>${escapeHtml(row.neptun)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.name)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.email)}</td><td>${row.has_password?'Created':'Not created'}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.email_status)}</td><td><button class="teacher-button" type="button" data-password-neptun="${escapeHtml(row.neptun)}" ${passwordBusy?'disabled':''}>${row.has_password?'Reset password & email':'Create password & email'}</button></td></tr>`).join('');
 pwEl('passwordLoad').disabled=passwordBusy;pwEl('passwordInitial').disabled=passwordBusy;
}
async function passwordLoad(){
 if(passwordBusy)return;passwordBusy=true;passwordRender();pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent='Loading students…';
 try{const d=await passwordApi('GET');passwordRows=d.students;pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent=`${passwordRows.length} students loaded.`+(d.email_configured?'':' Email sending is not configured yet.');}
 catch(e){pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent=e.message;}
 finally{passwordBusy=false;passwordRender();}
}
async function passwordSend(neptun,initialOnly=false){
 const d=await passwordApi('POST',{neptun,initial_only:initialOnly});
 const row=passwordRows.find(r=>r.neptun===neptun);if(row&&!d.status.startsWith('Skipped')){row.has_password=true;row.email_status=d.status;}
 return d;
}
pwEl('passwordLoad').addEventListener('click',passwordLoad);
pwEl('passwordBody').addEventListener('click',async e=>{
 const button=e.target.closest('button[data-password-neptun]');if(!button||passwordBusy)return;
 const neptun=button.dataset.passwordNeptun;
 const row=passwordRows.find(r=>r.neptun===neptun);
 if(!window.confirm(`${row?.has_password?'Replace the current password':'Create a password'} for ${neptun} and email it to ${row?.email}?`))return;
 passwordBusy=true;passwordRender();pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent='Sending…';
 try{const d=await passwordSend(neptun);pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent=`${neptun}: ${d.status}. ${d.error||''}`;}
 catch(e){pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent=e.message;}
 finally{passwordBusy=false;passwordRender();}
});
pwEl('passwordInitial').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
 if(passwordBusy)return;
 const rows=passwordRows.filter(r=>!r.has_password);
 if(!rows.length){pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent='Load the group first. No students without passwords are currently listed.';return;}
 if(!window.confirm(`Create and email ${rows.length} initial passwords for the loaded group? Existing passwords will be preserved.`))return;
 passwordBusy=true;passwordRender();const results=[];
 try{for(const row of rows){pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent=`Processing ${results.length+1} / ${rows.length}…`;
 try{const d=await passwordSend(row.neptun,true);results.push(`${row.neptun}: ${d.status}`);}catch(e){results.push(`${row.neptun}: ${e.message}`);}passwordRender();}
 pwEl('passwordMessage').textContent=results.join(' · ');
 }finally{passwordBusy=false;passwordRender();}
});

})();
</script>
